decisions.reason: As a close fit with the firm's core injection and fluid-handling business and with no clear sign of weak market acceptance, this product is likely to stay unless results fall noticeably below aspiration levels.

This resin injection unit also sits squarely in the firm's established competence base, so a medium-sized engineering firm with some slack would usually continue it while demand remains uncertain but not evidently poor.
An automatic airless spray gun matches the firm's main spraying equipment line, and sustained dedicated presentation suggests performance sufficient to justify keeping it in the portfolio.
A manual airless spray gun is highly consistent with the firm's core gun business, making withdrawal less likely absent strong evidence of underperformance.
Because this is a broader product line with several models in a core application area, it likely meets or comes close enough to aspiration levels to remain on the market.

The move from a dedicated page to only a mention points to weaker traction or lower strategic priority, so management would be more likely to reallocate resources from this peripheral digital add-on to stronger core products or new development.
